title: Savoury Crepes
summary: Thin, delicate French crepes perfect for wrapping Beef Wellington or serving as a side. These provide a moisture barrier between the duxelles and pastry.

steps.text: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter and salt in a bowl until smooth. Let batter rest 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Lightly butter the pan.
Pour a small ladleful of batter into pan, swirl to coat bottom thinly.
Cook 1-2 minutes until edges start to brown, flip and cook another 30 seconds.
Stack crepes on a plate with greaseproof paper between each one.
Cool completely before using for wellington, or refrigerate overnight.

tips: The key to thin crepes is swirling the batter quickly and using very little. First crepe is often imperfect - this is normal! Crepes can be made the day before and refrigerated with greaseproof paper between each one. For wellington, you'll need about 10 crepes to wrap a 1kg fillet.
